baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition, exception, property, and orphan construction in the opening clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse gates access before completed appropriation: practical contact with the property of a child cut off from a caregiver is forbidden unless the mode of contact is affirmatively beneficial to that owner.

activation_trace.role: Practical nearness and involvement make the rule govern access and handling before a completed taking.
Possessed wealth identifies the protected object as an estate rather than an abstract moral concern.
Severance from the ordinary caregiver supplies the owner's vulnerability and the need for substituted custody.
Beneficent and well-executed action makes the exception a positive best-interest test, not bare absence of theft.

changed_reading.before: Do not steal or consume an orphan's property.
changed_reading.after: Do not enter the orphan's property sphere at all unless the access itself is demonstrably ordered to the orphan's benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The limit clause linking reaching to full strength.
baseline_models.mechanism: Custody has an endpoint and a purpose: it preserves the estate while the owner develops toward a threshold of strength and judgment, after which completion without deficit points toward handoff rather than indefinite control.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a defined endpoint makes the custodial interval finite.
Mature strength, judgment, and experience supply the capacity toward which custody is directed.
Completion without shortage makes intact settlement the natural terminus of the temporary trust.

changed_reading.before: Keep the property safe until the orphan reaches an age boundary.
changed_reading.after: Administer a temporary trust toward capable ownership, then complete it through an undiminished transfer rather than prolonging dependency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated covenant noun between the command to fulfill and the predicate of being questioned.
baseline_models.mechanism: The covenant is not a one-time utterance: it is a protected obligation that must be maintained over time, completed without deficit, remain open to claims, and finally become an object of inquiry.

activation_trace.role: Full completion with nothing missing supplies the performance standard.
Repeated tending and review turn the covenant into a continuing maintenance duty.
A guarantee subject to return and claim gives the duty a recoverable liability structure.
Questioning and demand make performance answerable rather than privately self-certified.

changed_reading.before: Promises should be kept because they are morally binding.
changed_reading.after: The orphan-property duty is a continuously maintained, claim-bearing covenant whose complete performance must withstand inquiry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier parent-care sequence mirrors the focus's reach-event across the life cycle: parents reach old age after having nourished the addressee in smallness, while the orphan is to reach mature strength. Best-interest custody therefore includes cultivating capacity for independence, not merely waiting beside preserved assets.

activation_trace.role: Active beneficence toward dependent parents supplies a care model that exceeds passive non-harm.
A parent reaching the endpoint of old age establishes the first side of the mirrored dependency transition.
Advanced age marks dependence at one end of the life cycle.
Nourishment and growth make care developmental rather than merely preservative.
The orphan's corresponding reach-event gives the trust a developmental destination.
Mature strength and judgment name the capacity the custodian should help make effective.

structural_cues: 17:23 and 17:34 use the same reaching construction for opposite dependency transitions, while 17:24 recalls care during smallness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored reach-events and an explicit nourishment image; I infer that stewardship should build the orphan's usable competence toward handoff. A merely chronological cutoff remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Preserve assets while time carries the orphan to adulthood.
changed_reading.after: Treat custody as developmental work that prepares the owner to exercise mature control when the temporary trust ends.

context_deltas.mechanism: The resource sequence rejects both scattering wealth and immobilizing or fully extending the hand, then depicts allocation by measured restriction. The best mode of approaching orphan property is consequently calibrated management between inert hoarding and dissipative intervention.

activation_trace.role: Dispersal of wealth supplies the dissipative failure mode.
A limb held in a collar supplies the opposite failure mode of immobilized capacity.
Unrestricted extension of the hand gives the image of uncontrolled disbursement.
Deliberate estimation and planning provide the regulating alternative between the two extremes.
Practical involvement is the focus action whose permitted range is being calibrated.
Beneficent execution makes the calibrated middle answer to the owner's advantage.

structural_cues: 17:26-30 moves from giving rights, through a ban on wealth-scattering, to the bound-hand and fully-spread-hand contrast, and then to expanded or restricted provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed economic and bodily extremes; I infer that they specify the quality of fiduciary intervention licensed by the focus exception. They may instead concern only personal spending, but their sequence still sharpens the property-management mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Safety means leaving the orphan's assets untouched whenever possible.
changed_reading.after: Safety can require proportionate management: neither freezing productive use nor scattering the estate, but intervening only to the degree best for its owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact prohibition against approaching in 17:32 governs the path toward a prohibited act, not only its completion. Repetition in 17:34 makes the orphan-property rule preventive risk governance, while the explicit exception turns necessary access into a controlled best-interest channel.

activation_trace.role: The parallel approach prohibition makes preliminary involvement itself a regulated zone.
The completed wrong beyond that approach boundary distinguishes risky access from final violation.
Exceeding a limit explains why the route toward the act is blocked in advance.
An extended path makes enabling steps and routes part of the preventive mechanism.
The repeated construction transfers approach-level regulation to the orphan's property.
The exception admits only a positively beneficial route through the otherwise closed boundary.

structural_cues: 17:32 has an absolute 'do not approach' construction; 17:34 repeats it two ayat later but adds a best-mode exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact syntax repeated across two protected domains; I infer that both rules govern enabling proximity and not only consummated harm. The alternative is that 'approach' is simply idiomatic intensification.

changed_reading.before: Liability begins when the custodian actually misappropriates the property.
changed_reading.after: The verse regulates conflicts, access paths, and preliminary handling before loss occurs, permitting proximity only through a best-interest protocol.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby legal sequence names an owned right, grants a representative guardian effective authority, and immediately bars excess. Applied to the orphan's estate, custody is delegated jurisdiction for another owner's right, not beneficial ownership in the custodian.

activation_trace.role: A specific right belonging to its holder makes protected wealth someone else's enforceable claim.
Taking charge of another's affair supplies the representative office.
Effective power and jurisdiction show that representation can involve real authority.
The immediate ban on crossing the limit prevents delegated power from becoming unlimited discretion.
Loss of the ordinary caregiver creates the need for a substitute representative without changing ownership.
The estate remains the concrete object over which that bounded authority operates.

structural_cues: 17:33 places guardian, authority, and a no-excess restriction immediately before the orphan-property command; 17:26 separately names the vulnerable recipient's right.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a neighboring model of representative power bounded against excess; I transfer that legal shape to the custodian implied by orphan property. The live alternative is that the homicide guardian is too distinct to define orphan custody directly.

changed_reading.before: A caretaker owns practical control but bears a moral duty not to abuse it.
changed_reading.after: The caretaker exercises non-owning, delegated authority whose scope is fixed by the orphan's right and curtailed at the point of excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel materializes fulfillment as full quantity, balanced valuation, a straight standard, and a favorable outcome. The orphan-property covenant therefore calls for reckonable stewardship and a settlement that can be measured, not merely sincere intent.

activation_trace.role: The repeated fulfillment root carries complete performance directly into a commercial accounting scene.
Quantity measurement makes completeness externally checkable.
A balance of justice supplies a valuation standard, not only a count.
The explicit measuring instrument gives accountability an auditable material form.
Straightness and equilibrium specify the quality of the standard used.
Return to an eventual outcome makes long-term consequence part of judging present management.
A guarantee open to return and claim is the focus obligation that the measures operationalize.

structural_cues: 17:35 immediately repeats the fulfillment command and the comparative-good root from 17:34 inside a measuring and weighing construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition plus concrete instruments of quantity and balance; I infer accounting controls and an intact final settlement for the orphan trust. The alternative is that 17:35 states parallel marketplace ethics without specifying trust procedure.

changed_reading.before: Fulfill the covenant honestly in a general moral sense.
changed_reading.after: Maintain quantities and valuations that can be checked, and close the trust with a complete, balanced account whose outcome is good for its owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the predicate of being questioned after forbidding unsupported following and assigning answerability to hearing, sight, and inward judgment. Covenant performance thus includes evidence-based decisions and a traceable basis for how the orphan's property was handled.

activation_trace.role: Following an evidentiary trace supplies the decision path whose unsupported use is prohibited.
Disclosure to a knower sets knowledge, rather than conjecture, as the basis for action.
Understanding and responsive uptake make received information an accountable faculty.
Inner discernment contributes evaluative judgment rather than mere visual observation.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the deliberative center that is itself answerable.
The repeated questioning predicate explicitly joins epistemic faculties to the focus's accountability frame.
Continuing review identifies the covenant as the duty whose decisions need an evidentiary history.

structural_cues: 17:34 and 17:36 share the marked 'was questioned' ending, while 17:36 inserts knowledge and accountable faculties between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated predicate and an intervening epistemic audit; I infer a duty to preserve reasons and evidence for fiduciary choices. The alternative is that 17:36 concerns belief or testimony generally and only broadens moral accountability.

changed_reading.before: The custodian will eventually be asked whether the promise was kept.
changed_reading.after: The custodian must be able to show what was known, perceived, judged, and done at each decision affecting the estate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later use of reaching denies an impossible comparison with mountain height. That contrast checks a maximalist reading of full strength: the handoff threshold is attainable human competence appropriate to the trust, not invulnerability, perfect judgment, or unsurpassable physical power.

activation_trace.role: The repeated arrival root now marks a limit that human boasting cannot reach.
Piercing and rupture supply one deliberately impossible measure of human power.
A high solid mass supplies the unattainable comparison against which ordinary capacity is bounded.
Vertical extension names the excessive scale explicitly denied.
Maturity with judgment remains the attainable focus threshold being qualified.

structural_cues: The same reaching root governs mature strength in 17:34 and an explicitly impossible height comparison in 17:37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near repetition that contrasts attainable maturation with impossible magnitude; I infer a fit-for-purpose capacity threshold. The alternative is that 17:37 only rebukes pride and leaves the legal threshold undefined.

changed_reading.before: Control may be withheld until the orphan exhibits an idealized maximum of maturity.
changed_reading.after: Control should pass at sufficient functional competence; demanding perfection would convert protective custody into indefinite domination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant س ل ل mapping for the focus's questioning word rather than its ordinary س ء ل morphology. It remains worth carrying as an overlay because hidden withdrawal attaches to the focus's property-and-access construction and is reinforced by nearby wealth dispersion and concealed betrayal; downstream prose must label it a lexical activation, never a translation replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The questioned covenant stands beside prohibited access to the orphan's wealth.

activation_trace.role: Gentle or hidden extraction overlays answerability with the risk of value being drawn out unnoticed.
Concealed betrayal supplies the agency by which small withdrawals can evade open accounting.
Scattering wealth supplies the cumulative material result of leakage.
Regulated involvement provides the access point at which hidden extraction must be prevented.

changed_reading.before: The final clause only announces future questioning about covenant performance.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory overlay, the covenant also functions as an anti-leakage control against gradual, concealed withdrawals from the orphan's estate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends the branch image of singular isolation from the orphan to the accounting identity of the estate. It remains anchored in the orphan-property phrase, the claim-bearing covenant, and the next ayah's measurements; downstream prose should present separate traceability as a custodial implication, not as the lexical meaning of orphanhood.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The orphan is both a severed dependent and an isolated individual whose property is governed by a recoverable covenant.

activation_trace.role: Singular separation makes the beneficiary legible as an individually identifiable claim rather than part of an anonymous pool.
Concrete possessed wealth supplies the estate whose identity can be preserved.
A guarantee subject to claim and return requires the beneficiary's portion to remain recoverable.
Discrete quantity measurement supplies a practical means of preserving each estate's identity.
Valuation by weight makes each beneficiary's preserved amount independently testable.

changed_reading.before: It is enough that pooled custodial assets retain their aggregate value.
changed_reading.after: Each orphan's estate should remain separately identifiable and measurable so that no individual claim disappears within pooled custody.

strongest_changes: The approach prohibition becomes an access-control rule: risks and enabling steps are governed before completed misappropriation.
The life-cycle and spending sequences turn custody into developmental, calibrated management aimed at competent handoff.
The immediate measuring and accountability ayat make covenant fulfillment auditable through quantities, valuations, evidence, and reasons.
summary.what_was_special: The window converts a compact moral command into a fiduciary system with a protected access boundary, temporary developmental authority, limits on both passivity and excess, measurable settlement, and epistemic answerability. Distinct readings remain live rather than being collapsed into one theory.
remaining_uncertainties: The maturity threshold may be primarily chronological and physical, or it may include demonstrable legal and financial competence.
The measuring and epistemic controls may directly specify orphan stewardship or may be adjacent analogies within a broader ethical sequence.
The anti-siphoning and ring-fencing readings are packet-enabled operational overlays, not replacements for the ordinary lexical readings.
